autoscan.desc: Automatically scan whitelist folders and add projects that contain `.dev-team-agent`.
autoscan.enabledInfo: When enabled, the dashboard scans the whitelist every 60 seconds while the app is open. Changing the interval in the UI is not supported yet.
autoscan.title: Project autoscan
autoscan.whitelistDesc: Each entry is a parent folder — scans itself and one level of children.

githubTokens.desc: Add a PAT for each private repo so issue fetch works when creating tasks. Per-repo tokens win; otherwise falls back to the GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

githubTokens.repoInvalid: Could not recognise the repo — use owner/repo or a github.com URL.
githubTokens.repoRequired: Enter a GitHub repo slug or URL.
githubTokens.title: GitHub tokens per repo

language.loadFailed: Could not load translations — keeping the current language.

logging.title: Logs

types.toolCall: Tool call (per-job tool invocations — for statistics)

logging.typesDesc: Log types (off = do not write and do not show in Logs).

modes.alwaysOnHint: Default dashboard mode — cannot be turned off.
modes.desc: Turn each sidebar mode on or off. A disabled mode is hidden from the sidebar and cannot be opened from anywhere else.
modes.logsAlsoHiddenHint: Also hidden by the "Show Logs mode" switch in the Logs group.
modes.title: Visible modes

browser.permissionDenied: The browser denied notification permission — grant it in your browser settings.

recovery.desc: Auto-recover jobs interrupted by usage-limit, network loss, or a process crash instead of marking them failed right away.
recovery.title: Job recovery

scanPatterns.desc: Paths relative to the project root, with * and ** support. A matched directory is scanned as a whole; a matched file is loaded on its own.
scanPatterns.empty: No patterns yet — defaults are in use.
scanPatterns.hint: Patterns are added to the default sources, they do not replace them. * and ** never match dot-names — type .claude out in full to reach it.
scanPatterns.invalid: Invalid pattern — use a relative path, no ".." and no absolute paths.
scanPatterns.loadError: Could not load scan pattern config.
scanPatterns.title: Scan patterns for agents / skills / rules
